(ns robot.core
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]))

(defrecord Robot [pos dir])

(defn move [{:keys [pos] :as r} cmds]
  (reduce (fn [r c]
            (case c
              \A (update-in r [:pos 1] inc)
              (\L \R) r
              (throw (ex-info "bad" {:c c}))))
          r cmds))

(defmacro unless-nil [x & body] `(when (some? ~x) ~@body))

(let [r (->Robot [0 0] :north)
      #{a} #{1}]
  (-> r (move "AA") :pos (str/join ",")))
